steps.en: Officer selects the notice to record payment for
steps.id: Officer memilih notice yang akan dicatat pembayarannya
steps.why_en: Only one notice can be recorded per search, not several at once.
steps.why_id: Hanya satu notice yang bisa dicatat per pencarian, tidak beberapa sekaligus.

steps.en: Officer keys in the amount paid
Officer keys in the date of payment
Officer keys in the receipt details
steps.why_en: The officer cannot key in receipt details; the system generates a receipt number and does not show it.
steps.why_id: Officer tidak bisa mengisi detail receipt; sistem membuat nomor receipt sendiri dan tidak menampilkannya.

steps.en: Officer saves and the payment is recorded
OCMS sends the collection details to Cumulus
steps.id: OCMS mengirim data collection ke Cumulus
steps.why_en: No link to Cumulus exists in the code that was reviewed.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada sambungan ke Cumulus di code yang diperiksa.
